**Important Notice: Northbank Community Garden Update**

Dear Gardeners and Neighbors,

We are writing to inform you of some essential maintenance work and schedule adjustments affecting our beloved Northbank Community Garden. Please read the following updates carefully to ensure your weekend plans remain uninterrupted.

First, please be aware that the north gate will be temporarily closed on Saturday, 18 April, from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm. This closure is necessary to allow our maintenance team to repair a leaking water pipe that has been causing issues near the entrance. During this time, all visitors must use the east entrance to access the garden plots and common areas. We apologize for any inconvenience this detour may cause and appreciate your patience as we improve our infrastructure.

Additionally, due to the ongoing repairs, the popular monthly seed swap event originally scheduled for Saturday has been moved to Sunday at 11:00 am. We encourage everyone to bring their extra seeds to share and discover new varieties for the upcoming planting season.

For those interested in helping with general garden upkeep this weekend, we warmly welcome volunteers! Please note that while all necessary gardening tools will be supplied on-site, volunteers are kindly asked to bring their own work gloves for safety and comfort. If you wish to join the volunteer team, please contact Mina, our dedicated volunteer coordinator, for further details and sign-up information. Let’s keep our garden thriving together.

Thank you for your cooperation and continued support.

Hey neighbors,

Quick heads-up before you grab your trowels this weekend. We’ve got a bit of a situation with the plumbing near the north gate—specifically, a leak that’s been nagging us for weeks (and wasting precious rainwater, which is just heartbreaking). So, we’re shutting that gate down on Saturday, 18 April, from 9 am to 2 pm to get it fixed properly. It’s going to be muddy, it’s going to be loud, but it’s necessary. Please don’t try to squeeze through; just use the east entrance instead. It’s a slightly longer walk, sure, but think of it as extra steps toward your daily goal.

Now, here’s the kicker: because of the repair chaos, we’re pushing the much-anticipated seed swap to Sunday at 11 am. I know, I know, you were ready to trade those heirloom tomatoes today, but patience is a gardener’s virtue, right? We’ll have coffee and bad jokes waiting for you there.

If you’re feeling heroic and want to help with the actual pipe digging on Saturday, we’d love the backup. Just bring your sturdy gloves—we’ve got all the shovels and wrenches covered. Swing by the compost bins to sign up with Mina, our volunteer wrangler extraordinaire. She’s got the clipboards and the energy. Let’s get this fixed so we can get back to what matters: growing things and gossiping over zucchini. Thanks for rolling with the punches!

The Northbank community garden management issues this notice regarding upcoming maintenance and schedule adjustments. The north gate will remain closed on Saturday, 18 April. Closure begins at 9 am and ends at 2 pm. Crews will repair a leaking water pipe during this window. Water access near the northern plot beds will be unavailable. Do not attempt to enter through the north gate. Barriers will block the path for safety. Use the east entrance instead. The east gate remains open throughout the day. Plan your arrival accordingly to avoid congestion at the single open entry point.

The weekly seed swap, originally scheduled for Saturday morning, moves to Sunday. The new time is 11 am. Location remains the central shed. Bring your labeled packets. Exchange surplus seeds with neighbors. This shift prevents conflict with the pipe repair work. No seeds will be distributed on Saturday.

Volunteers are needed for general cleanup after the repairs finish. Mina coordinates all volunteer efforts. Contact her directly to sign up for specific tasks. Volunteers must bring their own gardening gloves. The garden supplies shovels, rakes, and wheelbarrows. Do not bring personal tools unless requested by Mina. Safety vests are provided at the east entrance check-in table. Wear sturdy shoes. Mud may persist near the repair site. Check the bulletin board for updates if rain delays the work. We appreciate your patience during these necessary improvements. Reliable water infrastructure supports healthy plant growth throughout the season. Your cooperation ensures minimal disruption to daily gardening activities. Please share this information with fellow plot holders who may not check the online portal regularly. Direct questions to Mina via the community email list.

**Northbank Community Garden Notice**

The north gate closes Saturday, 18 April, from 9 am to 2 pm. Crews will repair a leaking water pipe during this window. Please use the east entrance for all garden access. This detour is mandatory while repairs are underway. We appreciate your cooperation in keeping the site safe and accessible for everyone involved.

The seed swap has moved. It now takes place on Sunday at 11 am. Adjust your schedules accordingly. Bring any seeds you wish to exchange. There is no change to the format, only the day and time. Ensure you arrive promptly to participate fully in the swap.

Volunteers are needed for general assistance. All necessary tools are supplied on-site. You must bring your own work gloves. Safety is our priority, so proper hand protection is non-negotiable for anyone handling materials or helping with cleanup efforts. Do not arrive without gloves, as you will not be permitted to join the work crew.

Contact Mina to coordinate volunteer efforts. She manages the sign-up sheet and assigns specific tasks based on current needs. Reach out to her directly if you plan to help. This ensures we have adequate coverage for all required jobs. Do not assume a spot is available without confirming with Mina first. Her coordination helps us maintain order and efficiency throughout the weekend activities.

These changes are effective immediately. Check this notice board for future updates regarding gate status or event scheduling. We rely on clear communication to keep the garden running smoothly. Thank you for reading and adapting to these necessary adjustments. Your attention to these details helps us maintain a functional space for all residents.
